name: Sakurai Ryou
source:
Class: 3rd year student in the regular class
Zodiac Sign: Libra
Musical Instrument: Drums
Hobbies: Walks

Haruka's cousin, and a third grader whom Yukari yearns over as if he were her older brother.
Ryou is a student in a regular class and the accounting officer of the student council.
As a student council officer Ryou has been doing great efforts working for days and nights in order to liven up the events his school is running.
